> Tracked from `RDM-011` §3. **Do not start until the trigger condition is met.**

**Trigger:** With the first published chapter - the first time any page carries a status other than "current".

**Milestone:** M3 - Platform skeleton

**Phase:** Platform implementation, before content production begins

**Breaking:** Non-breaking

## Prerequisites

| Kind          | Reference                                                                  |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Specification | `WEB-005` - component architecture; draft, deprecated, untranslated states |
| Specification | `DSY-006` - component library; badge appearance and variants               |
| Specification | `CST-010` S1 - the status vocabulary and what each status promises         |
| Principle     | `UX-7` - state is stated honestly where the reader meets it                |
| Task          | None                                                                       |

## Why it waits

Nothing currently has a status worth showing. The moment a Draft chapter is published, every page it appears on is making an implicit claim about its own reliability, and a generic badge cannot make that claim specifically enough.

## Definition of Done - additions

- [ ] The component is in `DSY-006`'s documented set, with its variants and their meanings written down, not inferred from the code.
- [ ] The status values are the ones `CST-010` S1 defines. The component does not invent a status, and does not accept a free-text one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Rendering a chapter whose front matter says `status: draft` shows the draft badge without any per-page markup.
- [ ] A status the vocabulary does not define is a type error at build time, not a silent fallback at runtime.
- [ ] The badge is announced by a screen reader as part of the page's identity - not decorative, not `aria-hidden`.
- [ ] Colour is not the only signal distinguishing the states (`DSY-011` S3).
- [ ] Every state passes AA contrast in both themes, verified by the contrast script rather than by eye.

## Definition of Done - universal

Inherited by every implementation task. `RDM-011` S1 holds the single copy.

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] The `CI` status check passes on the pull request (`WKF-004`)
- [ ] Merged by pull request from a branch; never committed to `main` directly
- [ ] Human-written commenting matching the codebase (`WKF-007`)
- [ ] Keyboard reachable, visible focus, correct semantics; no new AA regression (`DSY-011`, `WEB-012`)
- [ ] Both themes; above and below the responsive breakpoints (`WEB-011`, `DSY-010`)
- [ ] The JavaScript budget still holds (`WEB-014` S2)
- [ ] No specification left in conflict with the work (`CST-001`)
- [ ] Decisions recorded (`D-####`); architectural ones get an ADR (`WKF-013`)
